coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Packing work bag, checking phone for the day's program schedule
Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, emails and partner calls
Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
Continuing work: planning upcoming community events, meeting volunteers and updating program records
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner
Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing phone
Showering and completing evening hygiene routine
Winding down in bed, reading and setting an alarm on the phone
